I read the whole thing twice, which is more than it asked for.

Start with where it's flatly wrong, because that's the part that matters. It says it's unusually positive about my father. My father drove a Buick off Highway 60 outside Sikeston, Missouri, on the 17th of May 1946, three months before I was born, and drowned in a drainage ditch he'd been thrown into. I have one photograph of him. The man who took his place, Roger Clinton, was a good-hearted drunk who fired a gun through the wall of our house and beat my mother, and I stood in the doorway at fourteen and told him he'd have to come through me. Then it lists 'luck, higher study and your father' as one of the things that reads well, so it says it twice. If your method wants to plant its flag somewhere and say here's where we're not like everybody else, it picked the one square on the board where my life says no.

It says brothers and sisters read well and it says courage reads well and puts them in the same line. I have one brother. Roger sold cocaine to an undercover state trooper in 1984, did a year in federal prison, and the Secret Service called him Headache. I love him. It has not read well.

Health and energy read well. I had four vessels bypassed in September 2004, a lung lining scraped in March 2005, two stents in 2010, and sepsis in a California hospital for five nights in 2021. I've worn hearing aids since I was fifty. Energy, yes, I'll take energy. Health, no.

Now the other side, and I want to be fair to it. 'Illness, debts and rivals' reads hard, all three in one line, and all three are true and all three are specific. The heart. Twelve million dollars in legal bills the day I walked out of the White House. And rivals - I was the second president in the history of the republic to be impeached, and it wasn't policy that did it. It also says marriage and partnerships read hard, and I won't insult anybody by arguing. And it says living far from where I was born reads well, and that's right too: everything I ever became happened in Georgetown, Oxford, New Haven, Little Rock and Washington, and nothing happened in Hope.

The temperament page is the part I'd argue with most gently. Steady and self-reliant. I've been called a lot of things by people who worked for me at two in the morning, and steady wasn't one of them. I run late, I run hot, and I have never in my life been self-reliant - I need a room full of people the way other men need sleep. Happier leading than following, though. That one's fair.

And it tells me right now reads an ordinary stretch. I spent the fall of 2025 under a congressional subpoena, they moved to hold me in contempt in January, and I sat for a filmed deposition on the 27th of February. That's not ordinary. If a method can't see the year a man is actually living in, I'm not sure what the rest of it is for.

notes: Answered as Bill Clinton (b. 19 Aug 1946, Julia Chester Hospital, Hope, Arkansas; age 79 at answering) from the documented record, having read the reading first. Where the reading pulled, the life was allowed to win. (1) The reading's single stick-your-neck-out claim is that it is 'unusually positive about luck you did not work for, your father and living far from where you were born.' Father is the sharpest available disconfirmation in this life and it was answered against the reading: C8=opt1 (difficulty) at confidence 5, A10=died_early, A11=reversal - William Jefferson Blythe Jr. died 17 May 1946, three months before the birth, and the stepfather Roger Clinton Sr. was a documented abusive alcoholic whose Buick dealership failed. Living far from birthplace is the one part of that triad the record confirms outright (C4=opt1 conf 5). Unearned luck is genuinely opt1 (the 1978-79 cattle futures $1,000 to ~$100,000) but held at confidence 3 because the same period's Whitewater land investment lost roughly $42,000 and generated a decade of criminal investigation - I did not let the reading inflate it. (2) It calls 'courage, and brothers and sisters' favourable; the record on siblings is Roger Clinton Jr.'s 1984 arrest and 1985 federal cocaine-trafficking conviction, later DUIs, and the contested 2001 pardon, so C11=opt2 conf 4 against the reading. (3) It calls 'your health and energy' favourable; A4=four_plus, A5=two_plus and A6 list the actual record (1952 tonsillectomy and two months hospitalised with a broken leg, 1979 sinus surgery, 1997 quadriceps tendon repair, Sept 2004 four-vessel bypass, March 2005 decortication, Feb 2010 two stents, Oct 2021 sepsis, Dec 2024 flu admission, plus lifelong allergic rhinitis, GERD, rosacea, bilateral hearing aids, BMI 29). (4) It calls 'income, gains and friends' favourable and that one is right on the money arc - $35,000 governor's salary, ~$12M legal debt in Jan 2001, ~$120M since - so C10=opt2 conf 4 and A23=serious_past record both halves rather than only the flattering one. (5) 'Illness, debts and rivals' reading hard is the reading's best hit and is logged as such in D2, not waved away. Judgement calls and uncertain items, flagged rather than hidden: A1/A2 - the widely circulated 8:51 AM CST figure is astrological-database provenance I could not verify to a hospital record within budget, so family_memory / to_15 rather than certificate / to_5, and A3=unknown. A29=yes rests on Hillary Clinton's own account in Living History of two years trying and looking into adoption before the 1979 pregnancy; Wikipedia does not corroborate it and it is the weakest factual answer here. A31=extended rests on his own 2024 memoir Citizen describing two years of sleeplessness and rage after November 2016 plus the 1998-99 marital counselling, none of it a clinical diagnosis; 'brief' was the alternative. A22=none and therefore C12=opt2 at confidence 2 is close to a null - no inheritance came to him either way, and I recorded the absence as mild difficulty rather than as good fortune specifically because the reading wanted the positive read. B4=eldest is his lived position but he was in fact the youngest of his father's children (Leon Ritzenthaler b.1938, Sharon Pettijohn b.1941, acknowledged later). A9=60_70 averages the three grandparent lifespans I could document (maternal grandfather 58, maternal grandmother 66, paternal grandmother 62); the paternal grandfather is unverified. A17=under_authority is imperfect - elected office is not employment under a senior - but every defining success was inside government. A36=worse is driven by the Aug 2025 House Oversight subpoena, the January 2026 contempt proceedings and the 27 Feb 2026 deposition, plus the Dec 2024 hospitalisation, against a 2017-2023 baseline whose worst event was the Oct 2021 sepsis. D4 lists the technical chapters as not seen because the supplied text is only the plain-words page and its three house lists; D1/D2/D3 answer strictly to what that page said.
